question: Select the most appropriate op on to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**relentless**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights that sports require continuous practice and hard work. "Relentless" fits best as it means continuous or persistent, which aligns with the idea of demanding ongoing effort in sports training.
 
• "Relentless" implies that the training is never-ending and requires unwavering dedication, which is consistent with the context of sports requiring constant effort and commitment.
 
• Other options like "paltry" (insignificant), "abated" (reduced), and "faltering" (weak or hesitating) do not align with the idea of demanding continuous and unyielding training.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *In the contemporary times, sports and games are emerging as one of the brightest careers. It expects to ___1___ at a very high moral plane. It demands honesty and transparency. Sports further demand continuous practice, hard work and relentless__ training. One must understand that sport not only has physical benefits but also ___3___ concentration and inner strength. Not only this, one who plays feels that ____4___ overall personality has undergone a change for better. Besides, social connectivity or networking, games develop ___5___ spirit in players.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Paltry (थोड़ा): "Paltry" means small or insignificant, which does not fit the context of demanding hard and continuous training.
 
• Abated (कम होना): "Abated" refers to a decrease or reduction, which contradicts the idea of relentless, ongoing effort required in training.
 
• Faltering (लड़खड़ाना): "Faltering" suggests weakness or hesitation, which does not align with the context of strong and persistent training in sports.
